archetypes.name: dyn-md-fence-parser
archetypes.rationale: Fence open/close matching and offset slicing are easy to get subtly wrong.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect _split_sections and _fenced_line_indices in python/larch/issue/learn_from_bugs.py. Verify unclosed fences suppress headings through EOF, shorter or wrong-character closers do not end a fence, and section content offsets still match the prior h2/h3 strip behavior for STRUCTURED_BODY. Confirm h5+ and Problem/Evidence remain unmapped. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
